3,835 likes, 13 comments - casarthakahuja on October 11, 2026: "The caffeine in your Diet Coke and Red Bull is a white powder controlled by one company...

And 80% of the caffeine that you consume through such beverages in India is supplied by this one company...

I’ll explain how this business works...

So while there is naturally occurring caffeine that you get from your coffee and tea... caffeine in other energy drinks is added artificially as synthetic chemical...

This is a white powder called caffeine anhydrous, which means without the water...

These compounds are called Xanthines, where caffeine is a derivative or subset of Xanthines... and currently China occupies 70% of the global supply for it...

But in 2026, China has removed a rebate that it used to give its caffeine exporters, which means those from other parts of the world may benefit...

Now, as per estimates, the next largest player outside of China is an Indian company that has approximately 15% global market share...

And it makes this caffeine in Tarapur in Maharashtra...

This company is called Aarti Pharmalabs...

The China + 1 strategy seems so real that in the past five years, this company’s stock has gone up from Rs 250 to Rs 850, which means almost 3.5X in 5 years, and a 27% p.a. CAGR...

This is not to say you should invest or not invest in this company... but to tell you how the energy drinks market is growing so rapidly right now globally ...

And real monopolies are sitting not in replicating a US product in India, but in looking at such companies in industrial ingredients and see how you can fit into the supply chain...

Because when the world runs after gold, it makes better sense to sell shovels.

#casarthakahuja".

17K likes, 357 comments - casarthakahuja on October 10, 2026: "The chicken you eat is controlled by just two companies in the world...

These two companies own the genetic IP or the gene of most of the commercially bred and consumed chicken in the world... and I’ll explain how this business works...

The first company is called Cobb-Vantress, and the other is called Aviagen...

These companies sell “grandparent chickens” to breeders and poultry farms around the world, and the way they control their position at the top of the pyramid is super fascinating...

Imagine they have 4 breeds of chicken - A, B, C and D...

They will sell the rooster or the male of only A and C, and the hens or female of only B and D... These are the grandparents...

Which means no buyer of these grandparents can mate two As or two Bs together to create another purebred chicken...

All the breeders and poultry farms thereafter in the value chain breed A with B, or a C with D... to create parent chickens...

These parent chickens are further bred among themselves to create chickens that are commercially reared and sold in almost every country of the world, including in India...

So now that India has enough of these parent chickens, why would you need these two companies selling grandparent chickens?

Two reasons:

1/ As you keep breeding these chickens, in a few generations, the yield keeps decreasing, which means you may not get birds large enough or they may consume more feed, but weigh less... at which point, breeding more of the existing stock becomes commercially unviable...

2/ These companies keep innovating on chicken genetics to come up with new varieties, which could weigh more with less feed, be more disease resistant, may perform better in certain water and climatic conditions, so region specific varieties, and more such parameters...

So people have to go back in the value chain and buy newer sets of grandparent chickens from these companies...

Even in India, two of the largest companies in this industry have partnerships with the international players...

For example, Venkateshwara Hatcheries has a JV with Cobb... and they produce a variety for India called Vencobb...

#casarthakahuja".

2/ What are the current stats of this team or this player
3/ Provide an expert style analysis of this shot

You can either search for “India” as a keyword that shows opportunities relevant to India and pay up to USD 45k per annum...

Or look for opportunities in your domain like healthcare, accounting, finance, teaching...

The hack is to have a solid resume to upload, and an updated Linkedin account, which has enough keywords relevant to the task, so that you get selected.

If AI is going to take your job sooner or later, might as well make some while training it.

#casarthakahuja".

15K likes, 120 comments - casarthakahuja on October 8, 2026: "If you have a bank loan currently, you immediately need to take this one step as your next EMI is going to be higher...

The RBI increased the repo rate from 5.25% to 5.5%, which means by 0.25%....

So if your floating home loan was earlier at 7.5%... it will now be at 7.75%...

This means, you either have the choice to increase your EMI outflow per month to keep the same tenure, or increase the tenure to keep the EMI the same...

Most banks will silently increase your tenure... because they make more money by doing it...

I’ll explain the math...

Imagine you had a loan of Rs 1 crore for 20 years at 7.5%... your EMI would be Rs ~80,559/-... and you would pay a total interest of Rs 93 lakh on your loan...

When the rate changes to 7.75% and the duration continues to be 20 years, your EMI goes up by only Rs 1500 per month, and your total interest payout is Rs 97 lakhs...

But if you keep your EMI the same to Rs ~80,500 and increase duration to 1 year...

you end up paying an interest of Rs ~1,03,000/-... almost Rs 6 lakhs higher.

So take the option of paying Rs 1500 extra as EMI per month instead of increasing the tenure.

#casarthakahuja".

5,397 likes, 36 comments - casarthakahuja on October 7, 2026: "#collab An Indian founder just built a 2 Bn Dollar company in less than 2 years by finding a gap, which he could monetise...

The gap is not that a product is cheap here, which you can sell elsewhere for a premium... 

The gap is in the simple idea that you speak at 160 words per minute, and you type at 50 words per minute... which means if you could replace all your typing with just speaking, you would easily unlock 3-4X more time in your daily schedule...

Now you have to look at the numbers to believe it...

The product launched in Sep 2024... only on Mac... 

In March of 2025, it went live on Windows... and then absolutely blew up...

Such that by Jun, the company had just 18 people, and by November, it was worth USD 700 Mn dollars... in the first year of launch...

And it was being used in over 250 of the Fortune 500 companies in the US...

The company is currently worth 2 Bn dollars, and is called @wisprflowindia @wisprflow 

You have to see what it does... So it’s not a simple dictation app... 

You download it on your computer, as well as your phone, and instead of typing anything, you speak into it, and it sends that as a message on email, it corrects all punctuation and capitalisation automatically…

I’ve been using it for drafting emails on the go, and my biggest personal use case has been in writing several chapters of my new book, where I’ve literally been able to get first drafts out at least 5 times faster, and all while maintaining my voice in the writing, something that using other AI writing tools don’t do very well.

#casarthakahuja".

6,118 likes, 57 comments - casarthakahuja on October 6, 2026: "People are now adding cloves to their coffee…

Clove Coffee is an antioxidant drink being pitched among wellness circles… where you take a piece of clove, crush it and add it to a cup of black coffee every morning…

It’s said that the heat takes away the odd flavour of the clove, and the compound called eugenol present in clove helps with digestion and inflammation management, while being helpful in pre-diabetes…

There aren’t many studies to support the claims in medical sciences

But eugenol is slowly taking off in wellness circles quite like there is curcumin from turmeric

So clove could follow a similar path... where after this you might see eugenol extracts in ready to drink beverages... and two things will help the wave...

1/ Brands that fund clinical studies to validate the claims for the product

2/ As 70% of the cloves are grown in Indonesia, a great bunch is imported into India... and building a thorough supply chain in this may help.

Would you add clove in your coffee?

#casarthakahuja".

5,743 likes, 89 comments - casarthakahuja on October 5, 2026: "50 crores in funding is being given to anyone who decides to move their company to Qatar… as a relocation grant…

They are also giving subsidised housing, Co working spaces and waiving off registration fees for licenses plus giving you an entrepreneur visa…

And I’ll give you three hacks to improve your chances of selection…

This is a program started by the Qatar Investment Program and Qatar Development Bank…

And look at the terms on offer…

There are two programs, START and GROW, and here’s a dive into both of them.

1/ START Program: which is giving USD 1.1 Mn at the idea and MVP stage where you have to showcase them a business model, your innovation, and the capability of the founders

2/ Under GROW, you get USD 5.5 Mn of funding where your startup is already functioning, but they want you to expand in Qatar and the Middle East…

Here, you need to have at least 3 years of operating history…

Now here’s how you can improve your chances:

1/ In your deck, show specifically a plan for how much of the Qatar market can you access and provide your solution in and monetise, plus why Qatar is perfect beyond just the capital… show them why they’re good beyond just the money

2/ Build timeline based milestones and deliverables from your end against which they can map a tranche based disbursal

3/ Explain how many people will you be willing to move to Qatar or hire in Qatar because they want tangible on ground execution than just mailbox presence

To apply, you must visit startupqatar <dot> qa/en/investment-program

All the best

#casarthakahuja".

30K likes, 236 comments - casarthakahuja on October 4, 2026: "Before you take out your winter clothing, you need to know this...

Naphthalene balls, that are found in most Indian homes, especially to store clothes, is restricted for use, and banned in a number of countries for consumer products, including in Europe, New Zealand and China for a number of reasons...

Fumes from these mothballs are believed to be possibly carcinogenic, and long term indoor exposure can cause issues like destruction of red blood cells, as well as with kidneys and liver.

And here are 3 common organic solutions that exist in other countries, which there is a whitespace for a brand to solve...

1/ Cedarwood - people across several countries use cedarwood oil in a wooden block, hangers, balls or chips inside wardrobes to repel moths from clothing...

2/ The above is coupled with sachets with cloves, eucalyptus and bayleaf for fragrant based deterrence...

3/ And the third solution is airtight vacuum packing bags that keep all kinds of moisture, air and pests away from clothes...

The biggest threat from mothballs is to children, and given how much Indian parents in metros are spending on child care... it’s one of the biggest problems at the moment requiring an organic organised solution.

#casarthakahuja".

9,261 likes, 133 comments - casarthakahuja on October 3, 2026: "Diesel could become ~3X more expensive because of three things that are happening in the world right now...

For the past several months, the only reason everyone thought oil prices would go up is because of the Strait of Hormuz closure... but now two other factors have stepped in leading to the oil shock...

1/ Source
2/ Route
3/ Refinery

I’ll explain...

1/ Source Deficit

The world produces 100 Mn barrels of oil a day, and consumes just the same amount, daily... While the Strait of Hormuz closure should have brought the deficit by 20 Mn barrels a day...

We were saved by the Saudi East West pipeline and the UAE pipeline, because of which oil prices went up, but not by so much that the world would come to a standstill... some countries deferred some purchase and production... and the actual deficit was more around 5-6 Mn barrels a day...

But now that the Houthis as well as Iran have severely hit the pipelines... the world has literally lost about ~10 Mn barrels per day of export from the Middle East...

2/ Shipping Deficit

Now that both the straits around the middle eastern peninsula are shut... ships are traveling all the way around Africa, down to Cape of Good Hope, then back up to Europe, and picking up oil by passing through the Suez Canal...

This means, while earlier, a ship would take 19 days to take oil to Asia... now the same ship takes 48 days...

So the shipping cost of oil has gone up from $3 per barrel to $26 per barrel... which adds $23 of price per barrel...

3/ Refinery Deficit

Crude oil has to be refined to be turned into diesel...

And look at what’s happening to the world’s refineries...

Russia had 32 large refineries, out of which Ukraine has now destroyed 27... this is in addition to the destroying of the Gulf refineries...

And China has now announced a shutting down of its diesel exports...

And the world is currently in a deficit of 3 Mn barrels a day of diesel... 

#casarthakahuja".
